full_judgment: ATM Afzal CJ : This appeal by leave arises out of a proceeding under section 95 and 95A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 and is directed against the judgment and order dated 5th June 1990 passed by a Divisor Bench of the High Court Division (Barisal Session) in Writ Petition No. 29 of 1988 making the Rule absolute and declaring that the order of the Additional Commissioner, Khulna Division dated 24-3-1988 in Redemption Appeal No. 213 of 1985 was of no legal effect.
